description:

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Executive who can run day-to-day social media and paid advertising across several brands at once. You will plan and publish content, build and optimise Meta and Google Ads campaigns, and keep multiple brand projects moving to tight deadlines.

**Educational Qualifications:**
BFA in Applied Art OR Digital Arts / Multimedia OR Interaction Design is preferred.

**Required Skills:**

* 1–2 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, at an agency or in-house.
* Proven experience running Meta Ads campaigns end to end: campaign setup, audiences, creatives, budgets and optimisation.
* Proven experience running Google Ads campaigns: Search, Performance Max and Display at minimum.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms and what drives engagement and reach.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan, schedule and publish content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube for multiple brands, following each brand's tone and guidelines.
* Build and maintain monthly content calendars for regular posts, festive campaigns, product launches and offers.
* Brief and coordinate with designers and video editors on creatives, reels and stories.
* Grow engagement and reach through trends, reels, community management and timely replies to comments and DMs.
* Track post and page performance and recommend what to post more or less of.
* Set up, run and optimise Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) for awareness, traffic, lead generation and sales objectives.
* Set up, run and optimise Google Ads campaigns: Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube and Shopping.
* Do keyword research, audience targeting, retargeting and lookalike audience setup.
* Handle digital marketing tasks for several brands in parallel and deliver to agreed deadlines.
* Maintain campaign trackers and keep task status up to date.

* Professional

  **cultural alignment**
  with our brand and company values.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams and time zones.

**On-Time Salary Assurance.**

**Positive & Supportive Workplace.**

**Comprehensive Provident Fund (PF) Benefits.**

**Retirement & Long-Term Benefits.**

title: Sales And Marketing Specialist for agri products in domestic market and international market
description:
**Company Description**
SFOURV Hydroponics Greens LLP is an agri-focused organization specializing in hydroponically/Open farm grown produce for both domestic and international markets. The company is committed to sustainable agriculture, high-quality crop production, and innovative growing techniques. S4V Hydroponics Greens LLP aims to deliver fresh, safe, and reliable agri products to a diverse customer base while supporting modern farming practices. The team values integrity, continuous improvement, and strong relationships with partners and clients. This environment offers opportunities for growth for professionals interested in agribusiness and market development.

**Role Description**
The Sales and Marketing Specialist for agri products will be responsible for driving sales and market visibility in both domestic and international markets. This full-time, on-site role is based in Bhongir and includes identifying new customers, managing existing accounts, and promoting hydroponic products through targeted campaigns and direct outreach. Daily tasks include conducting market research, preparing sales proposals, following up on leads, and negotiating pricing and contracts in alignment with company guidelines. The specialist will collaborate with production and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries and customer satisfaction, and may support product demonstrations, training sessions, and participation in trade fairs or industry events. The role also involves tracking sales performance, preparing regular reports, and contributing to marketing strategies that strengthen brand presence.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and the ability to present agri products to diverse stakeholders.
* Customer Service capabilities with a focus on building long-term relationships, responding to inquiries promptly, and resolving issues professionally.
* Sales experience in agri products or related sectors, including lead generation, pipeline management, and closing deals in domestic and international markets.
* Sales Management and Training skills, such as coordinating sales activities, supporting team members, and conducting product or process training when needed.
* Understanding of agricultural products, preferably hydroponics or modern farming methods, and familiarity with basic export and domestic distribution processes.
* Ability to work on-site in Bhongir, travel as required for client visits or events, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software to manage data and create sales and marketing materials.
* Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred; relevant work experience may be considered in place of formal education.

title: Digital marketing executives
description:
**Company Description** 
 ReatchAll is a growing organization focused on helping businesses strengthen their digital presence and customer reach. The company offers a range of marketing and digital solutions designed to improve brand visibility and engagement. Team members collaborate across functions to deliver data\-driven strategies and measurable results. ReatchAll values innovation, adaptability, and continuous learning, creating opportunities for professional growth. The work environment supports inclusive, ethical practices and encourages contributions from diverse perspectives.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for Digital Marketing Executives based in Serilingampalli. In this position, you will plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across channels such as social media, search, and web, aligned with business goals. You will manage and optimize social media accounts, create and update web content, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure brand consistency. Daily responsibilities include monitoring campaign performance using web analytics tools, preparing reports, and making data\-driven recommendations. You will also support communication initiatives, assist in developing marketing collateral, and stay current with digital marketing trends and best practices.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Marketing and Social Media Marketing, with experience executing campaigns across key digital platforms.
* Effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication for internal collaboration and external messaging.
* Ability in Web Content Writing to create concise, engaging, and brand\-aligned content for websites and digital channels.
* Working knowledge of Web Analytics tools to track performance, interpret data, and provide actionable insights.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency with common digital marketing tools (e.g., social media management platforms, basic SEO concepts, email marketing tools).
* Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new digital strategies, tools, and industry trends.

title: Regional Launch Director SIR
description:
**Job Description Summary**
* Job Description


 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the
   

  

 launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional
   

  

 collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional
   

  

 launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing
   

  

 mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the
   

  

 short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close
   

  

 collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and
   

  

 support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Proactively lead the development and implementation of strategic regional launch readiness.
* Monitor the launch performance, competitive environment to quickly identify plan changes.
* Manage ROI assessments of tactical programs \& through collaboration with Commercial Leadership, develop and execute action plans to address competitive threats and/ or exogenous market events, maximizing pipeline value.
* Engage with other functional teams to ensure operational launch readiness of Region SIR launches and ensure E2E coordination to maximize commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Platforms on critical issues related to market commercialization, aligning as appropriate to their global product launch strategy.
* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.
* Provide leadership to the market team and extended functional launch team members including coaching, advising, and developing team members
* Ensure compliance with Sandoz policies and procedures and full integration into the Sandoz culture and support resources
* Perform other duties as required by the Region from time to time.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing
